fullPassage: Born in New York City in 1842, William James was brought up in a wealthy and intellectual family; his father was a theologian, and his brother Henry became a well-known author. During his childhood, he lived for several years in Europe, where he pursued a love of painting, but at the age of 19 he abandoned this to study science. He later entered Harvard Medical School to train as a doctor, but his studies were interrupted by ill health. Nevertheless, he eventually graduated and in 1872 took a teaching post in physiology at Harvard University. His increasing interest in the subjects of psychology and philosophy led him to write acclaimed publications in these fields, and he was awarded a professorship in philosophy at Harvard in 1880. questions.passage: Born in New York City in 1842, William James was brought up in a wealthy and intellectual family; his father was a theologian, and his brother Henry became a well-known author. During his childhood, he lived for several years in Europe, where he pursued a love of painting, but at the age of 19 he abandoned this to study science. He later entered Harvard Medical School to train as a doctor, but his studies were __________. Nevertheless, he eventually graduated and in 1872 took a teaching post in physiology at Harvard University. His increasing interest in the subjects of psychology and philosophy led him to write acclaimed publications in these fields, and he was awarded a professorship in philosophy at Harvard in 1880. He taught there until his retirement in 1907.

det.korean: 건강 악화로 중단되었다(interrupted by ill health).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ interrupted by ill health: Nevertheless(그럼에도 불구하고)가 이어지므로 빈칸에는 부정적 사건이 와야 함. 건강 악화로 학업이 '중단되었다'.
❌ ① acclaimed by his brother: '형에게 호평받다'는 역접 연결어 Nevertheless와 논리적으로 안 맞음.
❌ ② abandoned after his childhood: '어린 시절 이후 포기되다'는 졸업으로 이어지는 흐름과 모순.
❌ ④ awarded a teaching post: '교수직을 수여받다'는 역접 연결어와 안 맞고, 이미 뒤에서 교수직 언급.
det.tip: Nevertheless(그럼에도 불구하고) — 앞에 부정적 상황, 뒤에 긍정적 결과를 연결하는 역접 연결어.
